recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered typographic lockup featuring glowing neon tube effects against a solid black background. The design contrasts a heavy, blocky western-style slab serif with a fluid, casual script, utilizing a warm palette of yellow, orange, and red to simulate illuminated gas tubes.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between rigid geometric slab serifs and organic cursive script
Color-coded hierarchy using red/orange for the top tiers and yellow for the bottom
Simulated light bloom against a high-contrast dark void
coreInvariants: Warm color temperature (yellow to red spectrum)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central slab-serif word in the middle tier.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan, starting with the smaller slab serif, moving to the large slab serif, and finishing on the flowing script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black negative space surrounds the central graphic to enhance the glow effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow (inner tube glow and script color)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and Orange (outer glow and upper tier outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value for the 'light' elements against zero value background.
paletteRestrictions: No gradients other than light-bloom effects

letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are formed by multiple parallel lines to mimic glass neon tubes
Slab serifs feature rounded corners and thick, blocky feet
Script is monolinear with consistent weight and looped connectors
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a fluid, circular loop
The 'g' in the script has a deep, rounded descender

composition.overlap: slight vertical overlap with middle tier

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural slab serif paired with organic, handwritten script for a 'rustic-modern' neon look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif skeleton for the upper tiers.
Provides the fluid, monoline script base for the bottom tier.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid, deep black background with a very subtle, dark red radial gradient in the center to suggest light reflecting off a matte surface.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the text using a neon-tube effect. Use two layers for the slab serif: a thick red outer glow and a thin yellow inner 'gas' line. For the script, use a single bright yellow line with a soft yellow outer bloom.

verificationChecks: Do the letters look like glass tubes?
Is there a visible glow effect around all letters?
Is the script tier clearly distinct from the slab-serif tiers?

adjustableVariables: Color temperature (more red vs more yellow)
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'dead' spots in the neon tubes
Ensure the ampersand is stylistically consistent with the script
Verify the red-to-yellow color transition is smooth
Confirm the black background is not noisy
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a heavy western slab-serif (double-stroked in red/yellow) with a casual monoline script (single-stroked in yellow) on a black field with simulated light bloom.
